question: What is the formula unit mass of ZnO (zinc oxide)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**81 u**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **formula unit mass** of a substance is the sum of the **atomic masses** of all atoms in a formula unit of a compound.
 
• To calculate the formula unit mass of **Zinc Oxide (ZnO)**, we need to consider the individual atomic masses of its constituent elements: **Zinc (Zn)** and **Oxygen (O)**.
 
• The **atomic mass of Zinc (Zn)** is approximately **65 u**.
 
• The **atomic mass of Oxygen (O)** is approximately **16 u**.
 
• The formula **ZnO** indicates that one formula unit consists of **one atom of Zinc** and **one atom of Oxygen**.
 
• Therefore, the formula unit mass is calculated as: **1 x 65 u + 1 x 16 u = 81 u**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 81 u.***
